name: Branching Out Fund
summary: Small UK-wide grants for community tree and hedgerow planting, paid after planting is done. The fund opens in seasons and is currently closed, with a sign-up to hear when it reopens.

geography.label: England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland

reporting: Grants are paid after planting, on a claim form with receipts and photos as evidence of planting.

applicant_types.quote: Branching Out is designed for community groups, schools, not-for-profits, residents associations, Tree Warden Networks, small charities and many more.

geography.quote: Projects must be England, Wales, Scotland or Northern Ireland.

access.quote: Successful applicants will be notified within 5-6 weeks of a completed submission.

amount.quote: Grants of between £250 and £2,500 are available per application.

reporting.quote: Grants will be paid after planting has taken place, upon submission of a claim form, receipts and evidence of planting (photos).
